lead: Arlington sits between Dallas and Fort Worth, with newer homes, many renters and a large university. SootMend helps homes and businesses across the city recover from fire, smoke and soot.
risk: apartment and kitchen fires, electrical fires, and space heater fires during winter storms
why: More than seven in ten Arlington homes heat with electricity. Winter storms push families to space heaters, cords and ovens. Most homes are suburban houses from the 1970s to the 1990s, with attics and open layouts where smoke travels fast.

Arlington has many apartments, including student housing near UT Arlington. Kitchen fires and overloaded outlets are common causes. A fire in one unit can push smoke through shared attics and breezeways.
problems: Near UT Arlington and the entertainment district
tips: Plug space heaters straight into the wall.
Keep renters insurance in student and apartment housing.
insurance: Students living away from home may have limited coverage under a parent's homeowners policy; a renters policy usually gives better protection.
areas: SootMend works across Arlington, including Downtown, the Entertainment District, the UTA area, Dalworthington Gardens, Viridian, Southwest Arlington and East Arlington.

faq.q: Does a parent's insurance cover a student's belongings after an Arlington apartment fire?
faq.a: Sometimes, with lower limits, if the student is a dependent living away at school. Check the parent's policy. A renters policy in the student's name usually gives fuller coverage.
